https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides an automated cloud-based environment for deploying, testing, and managing software applications, enabling faster development cycles and streamlined workflows.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create and manage isolated cloud-based environments for software development and testing.
Users must be able to deploy applications to the cloud environment with minimal setup or configuration effort.
Users must be able to integrate the platform with their version control systems (e.g., GitHub, GitLab) for seamless code deployment.
Users must be able to view and manage active environments, including stopping, restarting, and deleting them as necessary.
Users must be able to access real-time logs and performance metrics for deployed applications in the cloud environment.
Users must be able to invite team members and assign roles or permissions to collaborate on projects within the platform.
Users must be able to schedule automated testing or workflows within the cloud environment to ensure application quality.
